compiled_state.title: [GREEN] Add bug-type-* no-overwrite preservation to plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_handle_edit.py
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Modify _handle_edit.py tag sync logic to preserve bug-type-* local tags when Jira inbound sync sends different labels.

## File to modify
plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_handle_edit.py

## Current code (around line 125-140):
The tag sync block checks: if jira_labels_clean (non-empty) differ from local_tags, overwrite local_tags with jira_labels_clean.

## Required change
Before overwriting, extract 'preserved_tags' = all local tags matching prefix 'bug-type-'. Merge: merged_tags = jira_labels_clean + [t for t in preserved_tags if t not in jira_labels_clean]. Use merged_tags instead of jira_labels_clean when writing edit_fields['tags']. The empty-Jira-labels safeguard (no edit when jira_labels is empty) must remain intact.

## Constraint
The existing empty-Jira-labels safeguard (lines 125-128) must remain unchanged. Only the overwrite path (line 139) changes.

## Done when
All tests from T5 pass (bash <test-file> exits 0), AND existing _handle_edit tests still pass.
